question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 1 5 4 6 4 5 4 8 1 9 8 3 4 (Right)

How many such even digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 5 4 6 4 5 4 8 1 9 8 3 4 (Right)

Now,

Even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5fdafa773fc9f7a411784f9d0902ab931f9fc66fcccbba7a53e4fd4377025f1.png] Thus, there are two even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
